import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static char[][] board1 = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] board2 = new char[15][15];
    static final int[] dr = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] dc = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[][][] nodeID = new int[65][15][15];
    static int[][] distToZ = new int[15][15];
    static int globalID = 1;

    static class Edge {
        int to;
        long cap, flow;
        Edge(int t, long c) {
            to = t;
            cap = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class FlowNetwork {
        int V;
        List<List<Edge>> g;
        int[] lvl;
        int[] cur;

        FlowNetwork(int n) {
            V = n;
            g = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                g.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            lvl = new int[n];
            cur = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long c) {
            if (u == v) return;
            g.get(u).add(new Edge(v, c));
            g.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
            Arrays.fill(lvl, V + 1);
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            q.offer(s);
            lvl[s] = 0;
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                if (u == t) break;
                for (Edge e : g.get(u)) {
                    if (e.flow < e.cap && lvl[e.to] > lvl[u] + 1) {
                        lvl[e.to] = lvl[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return lvl[t] <= V;
        }

        long dfs(int u, int t, long f) {
            if (u == t || f == 0) return f;
            for (int i = cur[u]; i < g.get(u).size(); i++) {
                cur[u] = i;
                Edge e = g.get(u).get(i);
                if (lvl[e.to] == lvl[u] + 1) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(f, e.cap - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        for (int j = 0; j < g.get(e.to).size(); j++) {
                            Edge rev = g.get(e.to).get(j);
                            if (rev.to == u) {
                                rev.flow -= pushed;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow(int s, int t) {
            long res = 0;
            while (bfs(s, t)) {
                Arrays.fill(cur, 0);
                long pushed;
                while ((pushed = dfs(s, t, (long) 1e18)) > 0) {
                    res += pushed;
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 15; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 15; j++) {
                distToZ[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine(); // consume newline
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                board1[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t <= T + 1; t++) {
            for (int r = 1; r <= n; r++) {
                for (int c = 1; c <= n; c++) {
                    nodeID[t][r][c] = globalID++;
                }
            }
        }
        globalID++;
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                board2[i][j] = line.charAt(j - 1);
            }
        }
        
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    q.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    distToZ[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int y = cell[0], x = cell[1];
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int ny = y + dr[d], nx = x + dc[d];
                if (ny >= 1 && ny <= n && nx >= 1 && nx <= n && board1[ny][nx] != 'Y' && distToZ[ny][nx] == -1) {
                    distToZ[ny][nx] = distToZ[y][x] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{ny, nx});
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (distToZ[i][j] == -1) distToZ[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
                if (distToZ[i][j] > T) distToZ[i][j] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            }
        }
        
        int src = 0, dst = globalID - 1;
        FlowNetwork net = new FlowNetwork(globalID);
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (board1[i][j] >= '1' && board1[i][j] <= '9') {
                    net.addEdge(src, nodeID[0][i][j], board1[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Y' || board1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                    int ny = i + dr[d], nj = j + dc[d];
                    if (ny >= 1 && ny <= n && nj >= 1 && nj <= n && board1[ny][nj] != 'Y' && board1[ny][nj] != 'Z') {
                        for (int step = 0; step < T; step++) {
                            if (distToZ[ny][nj] >= step + 1 && distToZ[i][j] > step) {
                                net.addEdge(nodeID[step][i][j], nodeID[step + 1][ny][nj], 1000);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Y' || board1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                for (int step = 0; step <= T; step++) {
                    if (board2[i][j] >= '1' && board2[i][j] <= '9') {
                        net.addEdge(nodeID[step][i][j], nodeID[T + 1][i][j], board2[i][j] - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (board1[i][j] == 'Y' || board1[i][j] == 'Z') continue;
                if (board2[i][j] >= '1' && board2[i][j] <= '9') {
                    net.addEdge(nodeID[T + 1][i][j], dst, board2[i][j] - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println((int) net.maxFlow(src, dst));
        sc.close();
    }
}
